technique_name: Generate a functional shopping list for a dinner party.
description:
- 1 package of pasta
- 2 jars of sauce
- 1 pack of cheese slices
- 2 loaves of bread 
- 1 package of frozen vegetables 
- 1 pack of meat 
- 1 assorted salad mix
- 1 container of butter
- 2 bottles of cooking oil
- 1 container of condiments
example: The dinner party consists of five people.
